display_information.name: CTO Assistant
display_information.description: Private AI assistant for Duetto R&D leadership. Team, budget, compliance, GFA reports, architecture, calendar, and meeting intelligence.
display_information.long_description:
CTO Assistant is a private AI tool for Robert Matsuoka (CTO) and the Duetto R&D leadership team. Powered by Claude Sonnet 4 via AWS Bedrock. DM-only — unauthorized users are silently redirected to a public Virtual CTO persona.

Capabilities:
• Team & org structure — headcount, contractors, pods, managers
• R&D budget — cost centers, work-type allocation (KTLO/feature/platform)
• GFA reports — velocity, quality, AI usage, work classification, pod rollup, risks
• Compliance & AI adoption analytics — assessment scores, Cursor/Claude usage by department
• Architecture & engineering — Confluence search (1,700+ pages), JIRA (856+ issues), 148 git repos
• Calendar — Google Calendar events and free/busy queries
• Meeting intelligence — Granola meeting notes and transcripts
• GitHub issue filing — routes to appropriate Duetto repos
• Canvas support — create and sync Slack Canvases from markdown files
• Memory — persistent project context via kuzu graph DB
• Slack channel intelligence — AI adoption signals from engineering channels (D5 scoring)
